name: Ameca
summary: Ameca is a social humanoid from Engineered Arts, built for face-to-face interaction at events, museums and research labs. It is known for detailed facial expressions and does not walk. The company sells and rents it by quotation.
sensors: 2 x 8 MP eye cameras, 2 directional ear microphones, 4-channel chest microphone, LiDAR and proximity sensors.
highlights: First shown by video on 1 December 2021 and in public at CES 2022.
Installed at Edinburgh's National Robotarium in 2024.
caveats: Not a mobile robot; it is used as a stationary social humanoid.
No public price; sold by quote.
